interface.shortDescription: Computer work, Codex context and optional Subchat sends.
interface.longDescription: Files, searches and terminal work, with selected Codex conversations, skills and compatible MCP tools. A separate Subchat MCP reads ordinary Chat history over authenticated HTTP by default; explicit browser-prepared HTTPX mode sends through a dedicated background Chrome profile on macOS. Independent HTTP-only generation is unverified. Development alpha candidate. ChatGPT requires HTTPS setup; macOS native Accessibility GUI requires a verified helper and OS permission. Compatible Peekaboo is an optional external provider. Hosting is not included.
defaultPrompt: Check this computer and show the available tools.
Find a file and inspect its contents.
If Subchat sending is enabled, ask an available ChatGPT model such as 6 Pro and report its verified answer.
